meeting.date.description: Label of the date of a meeting in the properties block.

meeting.decision.description: Lead of the callout linking the decisions a meeting produced.

meeting.deck.description: Tab of the deck on the page of a meeting: the original file, its preview and its extracted text.

meeting.document.description: Tab of a converted document that is not a deck on the page of a meeting.

meeting.durationHours.description: Duration of a meeting of an hour or more, the minutes on two digits.

meeting.durationMinutes.description: Duration of a meeting under an hour.

meeting.grouped.description: Mention next to the tabs of a meeting: the build grouped its files.

meeting.groupingNote.description: Note under the properties of a meeting naming why the build grouped its files.

meeting.notes.description: Tab of the written notes on the page of a meeting.

meeting.participants.description: Number of participants of a meeting, when their names are not pseudonymised.

meeting.pseudonymNote.defaultMessage: The names of the participants are replaced at publication by stable pseudonyms. The mapping is never published.
meeting.pseudonymNote.description: Note under the transcript of a meeting whose speakers were pseudonymised.

meeting.pseudonymised.description: Mention under the title of a meeting whose transcript was pseudonymised.

meeting.relatedNote.defaultMessage: A meeting does not enter the model: it brings passages, and sometimes a decision someone took the trouble to write elsewhere.
meeting.relatedNote.description: Note under the related pages of a meeting.

meeting.representations.description: Accessible name of the tabs of a meeting, one per file grouped into its page.

meeting.signal.commit.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: added in the same commit.

meeting.signal.content.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: their texts are similar.

meeting.signal.declared.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: the note names its twin.

meeting.signal.folder.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: they lie in the same folder.

meeting.signal.name.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: they share their base name.

meeting.signal.similarName.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: their base names are close.

meeting.signal.title.description: Grouping reason of the files of a meeting: the title of a document is the heading of the note.

meeting.space.description: Label of the space of a meeting in the properties block.

meeting.transcript.description: Tab of the transcript on the page of a meeting.
